scoring_rule: per target, z-score each of the 27 features over numbers 1..40, then average each unordered 6-feature subset

multiple_testing.p_value_method: continuity-corrected normal approximation to number-level binomial hit counts; exploratory, not an exact test

guardrails: every feature vector for target i uses only draws with index less than i
all 40 numbers are ranked before evaluating the target quintet
exhaustive only for the declared 6-feature equal-weight grammar
best-per-target formula is retrospective/descriptive, not a prospective forecast
no immutable freeze is read for writing or overwritten
Q86 covers six-feature subsets; higher orders require separately budgeted runs
